# Agent rules for this repo

- Do not sign commits as authored by Mistral or any AI assistant. Do not add
  author signatures of any kind — no `Co-Authored-By` trailers, no
  "Generated by ..." lines.

## Process management over SSH

- The remote shell running an `ssh host 'command'` has that ENTIRE command
  string in its own command line. Any `pgrep -f` / `pkill -f` pattern whose
  text occurs anywhere in the same command — including in `cd` paths, log
  file arguments, or a `nohup ... &` launch in the same line — will match the
  session itself. This repeatedly killed our own SSH session or produced
  false "still running" readings.
- Rules:
  1. Prefer `systemctl stop/restart <unit>` for managed services — never
     pkill them.
  2. If you must pkill/pgrep over SSH, use the exact process name
     (`pkill -x voice-assistant`) or put the kill in its OWN ssh invocation
     containing nothing else, so the pattern cannot occur elsewhere in it.
  3. The `[b]racket` trick only protects the pattern itself; it does NOT
     protect against other literal occurrences of the target string in the
     same command line (e.g. the nohup launch). Assume any command that both
     matches and mentions a process is broken.
